[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

[[Category:Scotch Covenanter Cemetery, Londonderry, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
According to her parent's family bible Rose Ann Glasgow was born 4 Mar 1799, the oldest child of John Glasgow and Mary Arthur. She married Alexander McKeown in Ireland and they were living in  Innisrush in 1821, where there second son was baptized. About 1824 the family immigrated to America and settled in  Harrison County, Ohio. Her parents also immigrated to the United states and settled in Guernsey County. Alexander and Rose had 10 children in all and lived in Ohio the rest of their lives. Alexander died in 1852 and Rose was the Executioner of his will. Rose lived with her son William in her later years and died in Apr 1886 after suffering several strokes. 

Children:
*[[McKeown-821|Henry]] born 7 Dec 1819, married Rebecca Paxton and settled in Iowa
*John born 17 Apr 1821, married Ann Parker and settled with his brother in Iowa
*James born 1823, married Nancy Adams, but died soon after their marriage after an injury while constructing a barn. He had one son born posthumously
*Mary Jane born 1828
*Alexander born 12 December 1830, married Hannah Alexander
*Rosa A born 1837 married William Forsythe
*Adam born 1839 died 3 Jun 1864
*Arthur born 12 October 1833, married Mary E Walker, fought in the Civil war
*Margaret Lavina born 19 April 1835, married Robert Logan
*William born 28 Aug 1842, inherited his parent's farm
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-822]] is assessed at 98% (proved). John Glasgow and Mary Arthur’s family Bible includes Rose/Rosanna, born 4 March 1799, among the nine children after their 21 May 1798 marriage. Her McKeown identity coheres with her son’s 1821 Inishrush baptism.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.
